title: Hub-style virtual network with per-subnet firewalls
description: A virtual network where every subnet gets its own network security group that denies all inbound traffic except (optionally) traffic from inside the network. Azure-reserved subnets (GatewaySubnet, AzureFirewallSubnet, AzureBastionSubnet ...) are created without an NSG.
security_defaults: Each subnet has its own NSG with an explicit deny-all-inbound rule
Subnets are private: default outbound internet access is off
Network policies are enforced for private endpoints

dns_servers.description: Custom DNS server IPs (empty = Azure DNS).

allow_intra_vnet_inbound.description: Allow traffic between resources inside the virtual network. Set false for full isolation and add rules with network-security-group.
